scientific_integrity: The continuum formula is proved analytically by an exact linear change of coordinates and an exhaustive two-regime covering criterion for a staggered lattice. Rational-arithmetic code is a reproducibility check only, not evidence for an infinite-parameter assertion.
scientific_limitations: The theorem gives the exact covering-radius profile only for the specific planar parallelogram pair used as the sharpness example in the source. It does not classify all equality pairs for the planar Brunn--Minkowski covering-radius inequality.
title: Exact covering-radius profile of the sharp planar parallelogram pair
